description: Canonical GitHub repository settings for OpenPhysics SceneryStack simulations (and SceneryStackTemplate). New fleet members often inherit GitHub defaults — apply this baseline instead of copying settings from a mature sim by hand.

appliesTo.notes: Primary targets are sims + SceneryStackTemplate. Other public catalog repos should match the same security/feature flags unless noted. Private repos (e.g. Baseline) get vulnerability alerts when possible; secret scanning / PVR may be unavailable without GitHub Advanced Security.

pages.notes: Set Pages → Source to GitHub Actions. Description + homepage come from structure/repos.json via scripts/sync-github-metadata.sh.

outOfScope: Code scanning default setup — sims use Baton shared-codeql.yml instead
Dependabot.yml file contents — see config/dependabot-*.yml + sync-dependabot.sh
